title: Zesty Jamaican Feta Casserole
description: A funky and velvety ovo-vegetarian Jamaican dish featuring feta, served in a mason jar. This kid-friendly recipe combines the flavors of Jamaica with the creaminess of feta.
instructions: In a large skillet, saute the diced onion and red bell pepper until tender.
Add the jerk seasoning, scotch bonnet pepper, and flame-grilled tomato to the skillet and stir well.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and crumbled feta cheese.
Add the bread cubes to the bowl and stir until the bread is evenly coated with the egg mixture.
Add the skillet mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into 4 mason jars, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
Place the mason jars in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the jars.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the bread is toasted.
Remove the jars from the water bath and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
